sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: General Partner Management Entity for Early-Stage Technology Funds

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Civil Law codified system (Civic and Commercial Codes) with strong Common Law-influenced corporate, securities, and maritime law traditions (Ley 32 de 1927; Decreto-Ley 1 de 1999)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement and Bilateral Investment Treaty
Panama–United Arab Emirates Double Taxation Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (national AML/CFT framework; creates the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and governs obliged subjects); Ley 254 de 12 de noviembre de 2021 (Beneficial Ownership Registry of legal entities, administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, with annual filing and event-based update duties); Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law governing the S.A.); Decreto-Ley 1 de 1999 (Securities Market; Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá/SMV); applicable SMV Acuerdos for fund managers and investment advisers; OFAC, UN, EU, and domestic sanction lists applied via UAF resolutions and Panamanian administrative practice.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (Registry is held by DGI/MEF; not open for free public inspection; access is limited to competent authorities and parties with documented legitimate legal interest; licensed intermediaries must file complete UBO particulars on formation and annually)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry in the entity's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (primary); Consular Legalization if country of origin is not a Hague Convention Contracting State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Shareholder/board resolution appointing the subscriber, the resident agent, and incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all UBOs (direct or indirect participation above 25%), directors, and officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police clearance / criminal record certificate for each director and natural person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police or judicial authority in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Institutional bank reference letter for each GP contributor or seed investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-clearance and continuous screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and fund LPs against the US OFAC Consolidated SDN List (de facto market standard in US-dollarized Panama), UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU and UK restricted lists, and Panamanian domestic lists (Lista Clinton/UAF resolutions and judicial orders). PEP definition under Ley 23/2015 covers domestic PEPs, foreign PEPs, and international-organization PEPs, including close associates and family members. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs and high-risk UBOs, including source of wealth, source of funds, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring of SWIFT and capital-call wire payments. Any sanction-list hit blocks incorporation until a documented risk decision is approved.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá — 'Servicios en Línea' online name search and reservation module (https://www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be registered in Spanish or in any Roman-alphabet language; non-Roman scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must contain 'Sociedad Anónima' or the 'S.A.' denomination. The registry applies a 'semejanza' (likeness) standard: the proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. Surnames and geographic expressions are acceptable subject to documented consent or context review.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period through the online portal. Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written 'recurso de reconsideración' with the Dirección General del Registro Público within 5 business days of notification, attaching a revised name or supporting legal arguments and the original rejection certificate. A second denial may be appealed to the Registrar's superior administrative level; the final administrative decision can be challenged by a contentious-administrative action (demanda contencioso-administrativa) before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within two months of the final resolution.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for formation and holding purposes where the S.A. designates its licensed resident agent's physical Panamanian address as the registered office and maintains statutory books and share registers at that address. For a licensed venture-capital GP performing investment-management functions in or from Panama, the SMV expects demonstrable operational substance (leased office, local compliance officer, staff, policies, and records); a purely virtual office will likely fail an SMV licensing inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance - online search and 30-day reservation of corporate name (S.A.)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Registro Público rate schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of charter/bylaws and preparation of incorporation deed (escritura constitutiva)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for standard S.A. incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of incorporation deed and resident agent appointment documents
Registry inscription fees (inscripción of the S.A. in the Registro Público)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on corporate capital amount and page count

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Panamanian resident agent / law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO registration filing under Ley 254 de 2021
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory/administrative fee for beneficial ownership registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille / consular legalization of UBO, director, corporate, and bank documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign Ministry or competent apostille authority of origin; Panamanian consulate if consular path applies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding file - UBO piercing, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, source-of-funds, and risk assessment
Certified Spanish translation and notarized legalization of foreign constitutional documents
SMV pre-filing regulatory consultation for the venture-capital GP licensing pathway

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades), as amended, particularly Articles 1-9, 58, 60 and 103; complemented by Ley 67 de 2016 and Decree Law 17 of 2016 regarding beneficial ownership and anti-money-laundering registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil / Siglo, Régimen de Personas Jurídicas
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Pacto Social) recorded as a corporation inscription certificate
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is required under the Ley General de Sociedades. The corporation may be formed with one or more shares of no-par value; paid-in capital may be fully or partially subscribed and paid as stated in the incorporation deed, and no escrow account is required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscription of 10,000 common, no-par value shares of the Corporation by the founding shareholder(s) at a price of US$1.00 per share is accepted; payment shall be made by wire transfer to the Corporation's corporate account and considered complete upon receipt. (2) The registered office of the Corporation is hereby established at [address], Panama City, Republic of Panama. (3) The following officers are appointed: President [Name], Secretary [Name], and Treasurer [Name], each to serve until the next annual general meeting. (4) The officers are authorized to execute all registry formalities, bank account openings, and operating licenses in Panama.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name search, reservation, and availability certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sede Electrónica / Departamento de Denominaciones Sociales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name reservation request via the Registro Público's electronic portal. Provide the proposed corporate name, corporate purpose summary, shareholder identification, and proof of payment of the official name search fee. Obtain the Certificate of Name Availability before executing the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application form
Proposed corporate name (up to three alternatives)
Copy of passport or cedula of the incorporating shareholder
Payment receipt for name search and reservation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as similar to an existing entity, submit a revised name list within two business days; the reservation can be extended once for an additional term by paying the corresponding extension fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and execution of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaria Pública in the Republic of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian notary to draft the articles of incorporation. The shareholders must attend personally or by attorney-in-fact to execute the deed before the notary, confirming the corporation name, purpose, capital structure, term, fiduciary or board structure, and registered office address. The notary will authenticate the signatures and issue a certified copy for registry presentation.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Name Availability from the Registro Público
Draft Escritura Pública / Pacto Social
Passport or cedula of all incorporators and officers
Statement of beneficial ownership when applicable
Address proof for registered office location
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies discrepancies between the availability certificate and the deed, restate the technical corporate details and re-execute the deed; no substantive penalty applies if corrected before registry presentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate registration and inscription with the Registro Público de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil / Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Escritura Pública together with the official registry form and tax payment receipt. The registry examines compliance with Ley 32 de 1927, orders publication if required, and issues a certified inscription certificate evidencing the legal existence of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: Notarized original and two copies of the Escritura Pública
Registry filing application form
Certificate of Name Availability
Payment of registry inscription and stamp taxes
Certified copy of the notary's protocol
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inscription is queried, the corporation is notified of specific omissions; counsel must file a subsanación and correct the document within ten business days to avoid cancellation of the filing, after which a re-filing fee applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and municipal Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipality of Panama — Comisión de Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply online or in person for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) using the inscribed corporate documents. After obtaining the RUC, file the municipal Aviso de Operación with the Municipality of Panama, pay the municipal patent tax and obtain the operating permit required for office activity.
required_dossiers: Certified corporate inscription certificate
Notarized articles of incorporation
Identification of officers and statutory auditor when appointed
Lease agreement or title deed for registered office
DGI tax registration forms
Municipal patent tax application and payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI flags incomplete information, correct the data and resubmit within five business days; municipal Aviso de Operación refusals may be cured by updating the business activity code and paying the proportional municipal tax.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Specialized fund-management licensing and post-formation filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV) — Dirección de Intermediarios y Fondos de Inversión; AML/CFT Supervisor (Unidad de Análisis Financiero)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the venture capital general partner will actively manage regulated private investment funds, file the applicable application with the SMV for a fund manager or administrator license. Additionally, submit the entity's beneficial ownership declaration and, when applicable, the AML/CFT registration before commencing capital calls or wire-based contributions.
required_dossiers: Certified corporate inscription certificate
Municipal Aviso de Operación and tax registration
Fund constitutional documents and private placement memorandum
AML/CFT compliance manual and program
Beneficial ownership form and identity evidence
Fit-and-proper evidence for directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SMV requests additional information, submit the complete remediation package within the statutory response period; for AML registration queries, present amended policies and complete director declarations to satisfy enhanced due diligence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) for commercial/industrial operations; Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV) for venture capital fund-management activities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación / Licencia Comercial Municipal; additionally, SMV Fund Administrator/Manager License when the GP conducts regulated fund-management activity

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Departamento de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Categoría I (low-impact reasonable incompatibility) registration for non-industrial office-based venture capital GP operations; no full EIA study is required for administrative offices without material emissions or discharges.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office wastewater must be connected to the municipal sewage collection system with no unpermitted point-source discharge; handling of electronic waste must comply with Ley 41 de 2007 and MiAMBIENTE technical regulations; no VOC or industrial wastewater emissions are authorized from the ordinary administrative activity. General solid waste separation and contractual disposal through a licensed carrier are required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (Review of fire prevention and evacuation systems); structural load inspection and certificate of safety for the leased premises from the municipality's architecture department; workplace health and safety clearance under the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) for office occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; fiscal portal: 'T@PA' (Tributación en Panamá).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must first formally incorporate a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) through the Public Registry. Upon incorporation, the resident agent files the company's Constitución and Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) application with the DGI via the T@PA portal or written form. The DGI posts an electronic credential allowing the entity to obtain its RUC, enable e-invoicing, and be recognized for ITBMS and corporate income tax filings. A certified copy of the Articles of Incorporation, proof of registered agent, and resolutions appointing the legal representative and fiscal domiciliary are mandatory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists under Panamanian law; entity classification follows the legal form under the Código de Comercio. Tax classification for an S.A. is entity-level corporate income tax at 25% on Panamanian-source income. No hybrid mismatch elections are available. A qualified entity may elect the 'Multinational Company Headquarters' (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007 and Law 51 of 2011 for preferential territorial sourcing and employment-VAT concessions, provided it generates certain services exclusively for foreign affiliates.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) - a value-added tax on goods and services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold in law; every natural person or juridical entity habitually transferring taxable goods or services in Panama must register for ITBMS and obtain RUC. A simplified fixed-rate ITBMS regime applies to small taxpayers whose annual gross revenue does not exceed the level periodically fixed by DGI resolution (currently B/.48,000.00 per applicable simplified-taxpayer regulations).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing on the DGI-certified 'Facturación Electrónica' platform. Taxpayers must use approved private software or the DGI T@PA module, transmit each invoice to the DGI via web services/API in near-real time, and include the DGI-furnished electronic stamp ('Sello Digital') and unique serial number. Clearance occurs prior to issuance; no face-to-face paper invoicing is permitted except under DGI-approved contingency procedures for system outages.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods: export zero-rating requires material exportation from the Panamanian customs territory, supported by a customs over-declaration (DUA) showing physical dispatch abroad. For services: ITBMS zero-rating applies only to exported services when the service is fully rendered outside Panama, is wholly for the benefit of a non-resident person, and does not relate to Panamanian-situs real estate or property. Where a service is partially performed in Panama, the taxpayer must evidence that the economic benefit and consumption are exclusively attributable to the non-resident recipient. Specific contracts, invoices, and methods of payment to demonstrate provenance and foreign use are required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única de Aduanas (DUA) / Electro-DUA export declaration with customs clearance stamp
Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill) issued by the common carrier evidencing physical departure
Inward Remittance Certificate (Comprobante de Liquidación de Divisas or Bank Swift/MT103 remittance certificate) proving the export sale was received from outside Panama
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If DGI determines that the zero-rating was not lawfully substantiated, it may recharacterize the transaction as taxable and assess the full 7% ITBMS on the gross invoice amount, plus monthly surcharges of 3% per month subject to a maximum collection cap under the Tax Code, statutory fines of B/.5,000–B/.50,000, and disallowance of all claimed input VAT credits. Intentional misdeclaration or document falsification constitutes customs fraud under Ley 30 de 2011 and tax evasion under Arts. 272–276 of the Código Penal, carrying imprisonment of 2–5 years and disqualification from public procurement and financial licenses. Export entitlements and goods clearance privileges may also be suspended by the DGI and the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no issuing central bank. The banking and financial supervisory authority is the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP); Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent of the State and as a state-owned commercial bank, not as a monetary authority. No separate foreign-exchange administration or exchange-control commission exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is a fully dollarized economy; the balboa is a nominal unit pegged at par with the U.S. dollar, and U.S. dollar banknotes are legal tender for all transactions. Both current and capital account transactions are freely convertible, and there are no legislative exchange controls. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, and repatriation of capital to non-residents are permitted without prior administrative authorisation; practical hurdles are limited to bank-level AML/KYC documentation requirements, such as board resolutions, audited financial statements, proof of underlying contracts, and evidence of the payee's legal existence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not impose any statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Exporters may freely retain U.S. dollars or other convertible currencies in local or foreign banks, with no obligation to surrender proceeds to a central bank and no minimum conversion requirement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low. Panamanian law does not recognise offshore digital e-money institutions as licensed banks. An offshore EMI holding a European or regional e-money licence cannot operate a domestic payment account, clear payments through Panama's local ACH system, or hold settlement accounts without obtaining a Panamanian FinTech or banking licence from the SBP. Tier 1 Panamanian banks will often reject or freeze wires originating from unlicensed EMIs because such flows carry elevated OFAC and FATF screening risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Panamanian law mandates a licensed resident agent for corporate maintenance, but does not impose a universal statutory requirement that directors attend the bank opening in person. In practice, Tier 1 banks require at least one physical visit to the branch by the beneficial owner or lead director during onboarding for a foreign-owned S.A., particularly for private capital vehicles. Remote opening is occasionally permitted for low- to medium-risk clients using apostilled corporate records, video identification, and an established banking referral; however, enhanced due diligence for a venture capital general partner generally demands either physical presence or a strict documentary package supported by an executive-level bank recommendation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex multi-tier ownership involving multiple jurisdictions, nominee shareholders, or historical bearer share structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate overview; beneficial ownership declaration filed pursuant to Law 23 of 2015; notarized shareholder register; apostilled certificate of good standing; board resolution appointing signatories; audited financial statements for the GP; and a written explanation of the ownership chain signed by the resident agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth and source of funds appear unexplained in a newly formed venture capital GP with no taxable history or prior audited accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fund offering memorandum and investor questionnaire; term sheets and subscription agreements with founding limited partners; bank reference letters from the initiating LPs; one-year projection of capital calls and management fees; notarized statement of net worth; and tax identification documents for all material beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Positive or fuzzy screening results for OFAC, EU, UN, or FATF high-risk jurisdiction exposure in the LP base or downstream investment pipeline.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed sanctions screening and adverse-media search results; geolocation and IP-address diligence for the platform used by investors; signed investor attestations confirming no exposure to sanctioned jurisdictions; detailed source-of-funds breakdown for each LP; and a Panamanian legal opinion confirming compliance with international sanctions obligations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: GP lacks evidence of economic substance in Panama, creating a presumption of jurisdiction shopping for AML purposes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for Panamanian offices; payroll and social-security records of locally employed officers; minutes of board meetings actually held in Panama; management-services agreements with the fund; territorial tax returns or municipal registrations; and corporate email/communications evidence showing central administration in Panama.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital calls are routed through direct SWIFT MT103 wires from the limited partners' bank accounts to the GP's designated capital-escrow or segregated collection account at a Tier 1 Panamanian bank. The MT103 narrative must identify the remitting LP, the capital call number, the subscription agreement reference, and the stated purpose 'venture fund capital contribution'. No Panamanian exchange-control form is required, but the receiving bank will apply its internal AML risk model, may request the capital call notice and underlying LP resolutions, and will require prior notification on any transfer over its reporting threshold. Transfers originating from OFAC/FATF-listed jurisdictions require executive-level bank approval and a documented investment mandate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Portfolio disbursements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for cross-border investments and via local ACH for Panamanian portfolio companies. Commercial letters of credit are used only for structured trade-related transactions, not for equity seed capital. Each outgoing instruction must contain the payee's full legal name, account format, and investment-agreement reference; the SBP-supervised bank is responsible for scanning beneficiaries, intermediaries, and countries against OFAC, UN, and E.U. sanctions lists and retains all settlement documentation as part of the transaction file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX options with licensed Panamanian banks

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Pago Anual / Annual Corporation Tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Directorate of Revenue (Direccion General de Ingresos, DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, via the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 March; payment is due between 1 January and 15 March for the standard US$300 rate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If paid after 15 March, stepped surcharges apply: US$350 by 30 June, US$450 by 30 September, and US$550 by 31 December; continued non-payment leads to late interest, publication of the company in official legal announcements, and administrative strike-off from the Registro Publico.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaracion Anual del Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry (Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the calendar stated by the DGI; standard deadline is 31 March for companies in good standing, reviewed by the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may suspend the company's right to obtain certificates, conduct acts in the Registro Publico, or process transactions; administrative fines apply under Executive Decree 461 of 2020 and the Tax Code.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Records Maintenance and Registered Agent Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent and, where necessary, Public Registry of Panama for share or director changes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ongoing; all changes in directors, officers, members, share transfers, registered office, or registered agent must be recorded and filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unupdated registers impair the company's legal standing, block share-transfer registration and financing transactions, and may expose directors and officers to civil liability for inaccurate corporate records.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies when annual gross revenue equals or exceeds US$1,000,000, when total assets require an audited presentation under DGI rules, or when the entity is regulated by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores, Superintendencia de Bancos, insurance supervisor, or other licensed collective-investment activity. A passive VC GP with no Panamanian-source income and below-threshold activity is generally exempt from a statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB; IFRS for SMEs is permitted for entities below the public-interest threshold and in accordance with DGI presentation rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain and annually confirm the register of ultimate beneficial owners; any transfer of shares or change of control requires an update of the UBO register within 30 days and an annual declaration to the DGI even if no transfer has occurred; filings must reflect actual economic ownership, protecting confidentiality while satisfying enforcement requests.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – USD 1,000 per year for registered agent, corporate officers, and registered office in Panama
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 5,500 for a small VC GP annual audit; if a review engagement is accepted, approximately USD 900 – USD 1,800

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation applies: only Panama-source income is taxable; foreign-source dividends, foreign capital gains, and offshore carried-interest allocations derived through a non-resident fund vehicle are outside the Panamanian tax net. Dividends paid out of profits already subject to the 25% CIT bear no further shareholder-level tax (0%); dividends distributed from Panama-source exempt profits attract a final 5% WHT. No general venture-capital tax holiday exists; zone-based incentives (Colón Free Zone, SEM/Panamá Pacífico) are not structurally suitable for a fund-management GP.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 202 — Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas, filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax portal (T@x/ e-Tax 4.0) under the entity's RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) and CAIR (Clave de Atención Integral Rápida). Paper filing is not available for active registered corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, supplemented by mandatory quarterly advance tax payments during the fiscal year (30 June, 30 September, 30 December) which are credited against the annual liability on Form 202; a final settlement is computed on the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual Form 202 must be filed within three months of the close of the fiscal year-end (Código Fiscal, Article 710); a calendar-year S.A. must e-file by 31 March of the following year. The DGI may publish administrative extensions to the e-filing calendar, but late-payment interest accrues from the original statutory due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 – Ingresos brutos gravables (Gross taxable Panama-source income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate revenue, management fees, advisory fees, and gains arising from economic activities performed or utilized within Panama. A VC GP must include only Panama-source receipts; carried interest allocated by an offshore fund is not Panama-source and is reported off-book or as exempt income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should ensure the resident director signs a board resolution identifying each revenue stream with a territoriality analysis; management fees invoiced by the GP to a Cayman/LP fund for services physically rendered in Panama are taxable in Panama even if paid from abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 10 – Devoluciones, descuentos y bonificaciones (Returns, discounts and rebates)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Contractual rebates, fee waivers, and reimbursements of fund expenses returned to investors; must be supported by executed side letters or fund legal documents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign investors should maintain a reconciliation between capital-call notices and expense reimbursements to avoid a DGI reclassification of rebates as untaxed distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 13 – Costo de ventas / costo de inversión (Cost of sales / cost of investment)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs attributable to portfolio-company investments, carried deal-breaking due-diligence costs, and the historical cost of disposed stakes. Venture-capital write-downs are deductible only when realized and economically evidenced.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident principals should document the acquisition cost of each portfolio interest with signed closing statements and SWIFT records; unrealized fair-value losses are not deductible under Panamanian realization rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, rents, professional fees, audit costs, regulatory licenses, and amortization that are necessary and proportional to the production of Panama-source income; related-party expenses must satisfy the arm's-length standard and documentary rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors must ensure that invoices from affiliated service providers are executed by written agreements, paid through Panamanian banks, and supported by time or cost allocation sheets; the DGI may disallow payments to tax-haven jurisdictions absent economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net Panama-source profit after applying the tax code's deduction provisions and reversing non-deductible reserves, shareholder distributions, and above-market related-party charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepare a bottom-up reconciliation from IFRS/GAAP books to the territorial tax basis; separate offshore carry and foreign exchange items that are exempt to keep the return defensible on audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 27 – Impuesto calculado al 25% (CIT at headline rate)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Straight-line application of the 25% statutory rate to Line 22; no preferential rate applies to a GP S.A. unless the entity qualifies under a narrow SME regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 25% tax is an entity-level charge and cannot be credited by non-resident shareholders against their home-country tax except through foreign-tax-credit rules in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 30 – Créditos por retención y pagos a cuenta (Withholding tax credits and advance payments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayments and any Panamanian third-party withholding certificates (e.g., bank interest withholding) are captured here as credits against Line 27; uncredited amounts carry forward or trigger a refund claim.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the bank certificates of quarterly advance payments and reconcile with the DGI's online ledger; overpayments are refunded only after a DGI 'paz y salvo' verification and designation of a Panamanian bank account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 33 – Impuesto por pagar o saldo a favor (Net tax payable or refundable balance)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final result after applying all credits; a payable must be settled through the e-Tax payment module by the filing deadline; a credit balance triggers an automatic carryforward or a formal refund petition.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the GP is 100% non-resident owned, the director must still request the refund in the name of the Panamanian entity and submit apostilled powers of attorney for the signatory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an administrative fine of B/. 500 (increased to B/. 5,000 upon DGI formal assessment), a monthly late surcharge of 10% of the unpaid tax (capped at 50%), and 1% monthly interest under Código Fiscal Articles 730–732 and 735–736. Failure to file after a DGI notice permits a presumption-based assessment, suspension of the RUC and Paz y Salvo certificate, and criminal perjury exposure for the resident director who signs a false sworn return.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid out of profits that have borne the 25% Panamanian CIT; 5% final withholding tax on dividends or profit-sharing distributions (including carried-interest allocations treated as profit distributions) paid out of Panama-source profits that were exempt from or not subject to CIT; 0% on distributions made purely from foreign-source income outside Panama's territorial tax net.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTA network is limited: in force with South Korea and Barbados, with signed/pending treaties with Spain, the Netherlands, and France. To invoke treaty relief, the foreign shareholder must: (1) obtain a Certificado de Residencia Fiscal (Tax Residency Certificate) in its state of residence and legalize/apostille it; (2) submit the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the Panamanian withholding agent before the payment date; (3) apply the reduced treaty withholding rate at source; and (4) if any over-withholding occurs, file a refund claim ('Devolución de Retención en Exceso') with the DGI attaching the TRC, the DTA article, payment vouchers, and corporate ownership documentation. In practice, treaty relief is irrelevant for dividend flows from fully taxed profits because the domestic rate is already 0%; the DTA matters chiefly for the 5% dividend stream, royalties, and interest.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 12.5% WHT on Panama-source IP and technology license fees, with treaty reduction to 5%–10% where the DTA applies and a valid TRC is presented. Interest: interest paid to a non-resident lender on debt executed and serviced from a foreign-sourced financing is generally 0% WHT because it lacks Panamanian source; interest on local credits or Panamanian securities is subject to a 6% WHT unless reduced by treaty. Technical or management fees invoiced by a foreign affiliate for services economically rendered outside Panama are not Panama-source and carry no WHT, while services performed within Panama are sourced and fall under the standard CIT/WHT framework.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: B/. 2,500,000 (equivalent to USD 2,500,000) of aggregate cross-border related-party transactions triggers mandatory preparation and retention of a Local File and the filing of the related-party informative return (Formulario de Transacciones con Partes Relacionadas / Form 34). A Master File is required where the consolidated group turnover exceeds B/. 85,000,000 (CbCR threshold). Below-threshold GPs must still retain contemporaneous margin evidence for management fees, expense recharges, capital calls, and carry allocations in response to a DGI audit demand.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 254 of 2020, implemented by Executive Decrees 585–588 of 2021) apply to resident S.A.s carrying on 'relevant activities.' A venture-capital general partner performing investment management, administration, coordination of investments, or holding of securities is a relevant-activity taxpayer. The GP must file an annual Declaración Jurada de Sustancia Económica proving: locally owned or leased premises; qualified personnel physically present in Panama; board-level decision-making exercised in Panama; and expenditure and output proportionate to the income booked. A passive holding or pure-equity participation may qualify for the reduced 'pure holding' substance standard only if the GP performs no active management; once management fees and capital-call functions are exercised, full ESR compliance is mandatory. Non-compliance precludes issuance of a tax-residence certificate and triggers fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Sham Distribution of Profits (Código Fiscal Art. 761; Law 8 of 2010)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends or carried interest out of exempt or non-taxed Panama-source profits without withholding the 5% final dividend tax, or artificially re-characterizing management fees as loan repayments to strip profits offshore without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment at the 25% CIT rate plus a 10%-per-month late surcharge (capped at 50%), a civil fine of up to 100% of the evaded tax, and criminal prosecution for willful evasion with imprisonment of 2–5 years and a fine equal to the evaded amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors acting as withholding agents are jointly and severally liable for the un-withheld 5% dividend tax; during criminal proceedings the court may impose travel bans, asset embargoes, and personal seizure of the directors' assets, including piercing the corporate veil where the S.A. is used as a mere instrument of fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Failure (Law 254 of 2020, Executive Decrees 585–588 of 2021)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a zero or nominal substance declaration while the GP continues to invoice management fees, or maintaining no local premises, no local staff, and no board minutes in Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to USD 50,000 per fiscal period, denial of the Certificado de Residencia Fiscal, cancellation of the entity's tax-clearance certificate, and, for persistent default, administrative dissolution proceedings before the Registro Público.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign a false substance declaration face perjury liability under the Panamanian Penal Code with imprisonment of 1–4 years and are personally barred from incorporating new Panamanian entities while the non-compliant company remains in default; the corporate veil is pierced to recover taxes and fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Compliance (Código Fiscal TP Chapter, DGI Form 34 obligations)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Entering management-fee uplifts, capital-call reimbursements, or carried-interest allocations with the fund or offshore affiliates at non-arm's-length margins, or failing to file the mandatory related-party informative return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may re-determine taxable income using the most appropriate arm's-length method, assess the resulting deficiency at 25%, add a 20% penalty on the underpayment, and accrue monthly interest; failure to file Form 34 adds administrative fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign transfer-pricing declarations lacking factual support are jointly liable for the penalty component and may be subject to criminal charges of false tax documentation; resignation does not extinguish liability where the director approved the offending transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money-Laundering Violations (Law 23 of 2015; Law 126 of 2020, UAF regime)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving investor capital-call funds in cash or from unverified sources without a UAF-compliant client due-diligence file, failing to appoint a compliance officer, or executing Swift transfers to shell jurisdictions without beneficial-ownership records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines from USD 10,000 to USD 1,000,000 per violation, suspension of operations, freezing of bank accounts by UAF order, cancellation of the company's registration with the Registro Público, and confiscation of assets through the 'extinción de dominio' mechanism even absent a criminal conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the compliance officer incur personal criminal exposure of 5–12 years' imprisonment for aggravated money-laundering; preventive travel bans and passport retention may be ordered during investigation, and corporate-veil piercing applies where the S.A. is a conduit for third-party illicit funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Willful Non-Filing / Chronic Delinquency (Código Fiscal Arts. 710, 730–736)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Ignoring the annual CIT return, quarterly advance payments, the ESR substance return, and the related-party Form 34 after incorporation, while continuing to maintain a Panamanian bank account and invoicing investors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cumulative penalties: B/. 500 to B/. 5,000 per unfiled return, 10%-per-month surcharge capped at 50% of the unpaid tax, 1% monthly interest, automatic presumption-based assessment, suspension of the RUC and Paz y Salvo, and blocking of any dividend remittance or notarial act before the Registro Público.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The resident director is personally responsible for surcharges where he or she failed to instruct filing; Panamanian courts may impose a preventive exit ban, and the director is disqualified from serving on any other Panamanian corporation until the outstanding liabilities are settled, effectively piercing the veil to the company's beneficial owners.
